test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

WINDOW : XFOELX :: TICKET : UFDLBU :: REGION : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Consonants + 1,**

**Vowels - 3.**

​​So,

 
• WINDOW : XFOELX​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0b2fad59303dd107d43ce62206c780637004f2e52d12738c18db41aa1f3a94c.png] 

And,

 
• TICKET : UFDLBU​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/722852946bf0410ca8fcab36beced35a6d93ea5ace2b97437bdd5eb576432fe8.png] 

Similarly,

 
• REGION : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91eca74a09ef128ed2871942b6134ca82687135653e7c8f1b359d956642bcdab.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****SBHFLO**".

74:T84
